title: Ground state energy of the dilute Bose-Hubbard gas on Bravais lattices
summary: We study interacting bosons on a three-dimensional Bravais lattice with positive hopping amplitudes and on-site repulsive interactions. We prove that, in the dilute limit $ρ\to 0$, the ground state energy density satisfies $$e_0(ρ) = 4πa ρ^2 \big(1+O(ρ^{1/6})\big),$$ where $a$ is the lattice scattering length defined through the corresponding two-body problem. This establishes the analogue of the Dyson and Lieb-Yngvason theorems for the Bose-Hubbard gas.
